messages:
Maria: Heads-up — consolidated follow-up from the Alexon Private deployment postmortem. I pulled the action items that need owners and a cadence for verification. TL;DR: VPC peering flaps + on‑prem NAT churn + isolation bug in the edge proxy.

Sam: Thanks. Can you paste the short action list here? I can triage ownership for the first sprint.

Maria: Sure — quick list: 1) Peering reconnection hardening (retry/backoff) — owner TBD. 2) Onprem NAT mapping visibility — owner TBD. 3) Edge proxy isolation bug (race in handshake) — owner TBD. 4) Add recurring semiweekly checks for peering stability — owner TBD. 5) Postmortem test set into Redwood Optimize to catch regressions — owner TBD.

Kevin: I can take #3 (edge proxy race). Seen similar in Kestrel last year; probable KV cache reinit timing. I'll create a quick repro. :mag:

Olivia: I can own #4 (semiweekly checks) — I'll add a small script in infra repo and schedule a cron in the dedicated monitoring account. Need the exact checklist tho.

Sam: I'll pick #1 (peering reconnection). For retries/backoff, we should standardize on exponential with jitter + circuit-breaker so we don't hammer the peer on flaps.

Maria: Great. Kevin, Sam, Olivia — assign tickets and share links here. I put initial acceptance criteria: (a) peering drift < 1/hour on average over 7d, (b) NAT mapping visibility shows stale mapping < 5min, (c) isolation repro covered by test, (d) weekly automated smoke run green.

Kevin: Created INC-AX-4123 for edge proxy bug, linked repro steps and a small heap log snippet. Will try a fix today.

Sam: Created INC-AX-4124 for peering retry policy. Proposal in PR: ```yaml
backoff:
  base: 200ms
  factor: 2
  max: 30s
jitter: full
circuit_breaker:
  threshold: 5
  window: 1m
```

Olivia: Added infra job INC-AX-4125 to run the semiweekly checks. Script posts to #incidents with a short report. Draft checklist: `BGP status`, `VPC route table consistency`, `peering handshake latency`, `packet-loss probe`, `peer CPU/temp`. Want to add anything?

Maria: Add `NAT mapping staleness` and `conntrack table size` to the checklist. Also include a link to the onprem runbook for escalation: https://go.redwood/runbooks/onprem-peering (internal).

Sam: Quick note — the dedicated peer has an intermittent MTU mismatch that causes fragmentation and a subsequent reconnect cascade. I added an MTU probe to INC-AX-4124 tests.

Kevin: Repro update: the isolation race triggers when the peer drops SYNs during KV cache warm-up. Patch idea: delay accepting traffic until KV restored + passive backoff. Trying now.

Olivia: Semiweekly job scheduled for Mon/Thu 02:30 UTC. First run will be tomorrow; I'll post results to this thread. :calendar:

IncidentBot: [automation] Job INC-AX-4125 started by Olivia at 2512346780 — running checks.

Sam: FYI we should coordinate with the customer's onprem team before aggressive retries — they have an appliance that rate-limits new sessions. I'll loop in @alex-cust.

Maria: Good call. @alex-cust tagging would be: Alex (Systems) — could we get a timeslot for a brief sync this week? We want to validate our retry/circuit-breaker plan.

Kevin: Quick question on timelines — looking at codebase, I can ship a prototype patch by EOD if nothing unexpected. Need a short QA window.

Maria: Let's put tentative timelines: Kevin PR by EOD, Sam PR by tomorrow EOD, Olivia infra job running and reporting tomorrow morning. Owners, please block 2h for peer coordination when we schedule.

Sam: Noted. I'll prepare a short runbook blurb describing safe retry parameters for onprem peers and add to the Dedicated customer handbook.

Olivia: Job finished — short report: `peering handshake latency 120ms (avg)`, `MTU mismatch detected on 1 peer`, `NAT mapping staleness 7s (peak)`, `no packet-loss`. Posting artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/INC-AX-4125/report-2512346780.json

Maria: Excellent. That MTU mismatch dovetails with Sam's note. Can we prioritize a scheduled maintenance window with the customer to normalize MTU and test?

Sam: I'll propose windows and include an API to gracefully drain connections before retrying.

Kevin: Patch PR: https://scm.redwood/patch/AX-4123. Implemented `kv_warmup_block: true` and a 500ms passive delay. Tests: reproduce failure -> pass.

Olivia: Semiweekly report parsed and posted to dashboard; added a flaky-check alert if handshake latency spikes > 300ms.

Maria: Ok next steps summary: - Kevin owns edge proxy patch (INC-AX-4123) — target QA in 48h. - Sam owns peering retry/circuit-box and MTU probe (INC-AX-4124) — target staging deploy in 72h. - Olivia owns semiweekly checks and dashboards (INC-AX-4125) — on prod schedule. - Maria will coordinate customer sync and track timelines.

Sam: Adding a recurring reminder in the incidents channel for a brief sync after each semiweekly run.

Kevin: I'll add the postmortem test to Redwood Optimize evals once patch is cut.

Maria: Thanks team. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and these timelines. Please add any blocker comments here. :thumbsup:

Olivia: No blockers from infra side.

Sam: Waiting on customer availability for MTU maintenance.

Kevin: One small risk — the passive delay might slightly increase cold-start latency. Will measure and rollback plan included in PR.

Maria: Noted. Closing the loop for now — we'll reconvene after the first semiweekly run and the staging deploys.

IncidentBot: [automation] Thread tagged with `postmortem-followup` and `dedicated-onprem`.
